target.description: The schema the linked block is expected to conform to. Advisory: a validator does not dereference the link.

description.description: What the link is for, when it is written inline; a published schema is described by its page.

params.description: Type parameters that make this schema generic, each with its default schema.

name.description: Legacy: a name some published schemas still carry. New schemas are named by their page.

description: A schema for a link: a CID pointing at a separate block, optionally typed by `target`.
